name: Bharat Forge
about: Bharat Forge Limited (BFL), is the flagship company of the USD 3.5 billion Kalyani Group and a global leader in metal forming. With a presence across eight manufacturing locations in India, Germany, and Sweden, BFL provides high-performance, critical components to sectors such as automotive, aerospace, defense, and more. The company boasts the largest repository of metallurgical knowledge in the region and offers comprehensive services from concept to product validation. As the world’s largest forging company, BFL serves global automotive OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers, driving India’s transformation into a global economic powerhouse while expanding into capital goods and infrastructure sectors.
